text:
maria_sec: Auditor asked for a compact end-to-end sample showing RBAC change + KMS decrypts for inference-service. Scope: prod, last 30 days, 10 users. Need approval artifacts, k8s audit snippet, KMS logs, and two full correlated API traces. Deadline EOD.

auditor_jane: Confirm raw JSON snippets + a short mapping to SOC2/ISO controls is fine. Also need MD5 checksums for files.

tom_infra: I can export RoleBinding diffs and CHG ticket metadata. Will include PR and deploy manifest hash. Example k8s audit snippet we'll include: `{"verb":"update","objectRef":{"resource":"rolebindings","name":"inference-readers"},"user":"deploy-bot","timestamp":"2025-11-14T15:22:58Z"}`

sam_sre: For KMS decrypts we'll pull CloudKMS audit logs. Splunk query we'll use: `index=prod_kms action=Decrypt earliest=-30d@d | fields user,keyName,requestId,timestamp | head 200`. We'll include three sanitized entries and two correlated http traces using x-rw-request-id.

olivia_prod: I'll supply the 10-user sample (cross-team) and note which users were in the canary. Two users hit the canary window on 2025-11-14; there was a brief <5m error spike (INC-2025-349).

maria_sec: Good. Tom/sam: include approval emails (scrubbed), JIRA CHG link, and gcloud export of key IAM: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy inference-key --location=global --keyring=inference-ring --format=json`. Add rotation schedule and who can decrypt.

security-bot: Automated: creating evidence bundle id=bndl-20251115-22, generating manifest and checksums, uploading to s3.

security-bot: Automated: bundle uploaded s3://redwood-evidence/exports/bndl-20251115-22.zip, manifest: s3://redwood-evidence/exports/bndl-20251115-22-manifest.txt

auditor_jane: Received link. I'll validate checksums and mapping doc. One follow-up after review: proof of 30-day export retention for GKE audit logs.

maria_sec: Noted, will add export retention proof if requested. Thanks everyone—assembling bundle now. :thumbsup:
